description: Gas per op across an input ladder. First four forms are FP127; the first two and the third include the external call. FP127Lib and the competitors are the internal library call alone, timed inside the harness's entry point net of its dispatch. null = no measurement on that input; reverts counts, per form, the inputs where the form offers the op but reverted or the input is outside its domain or format; a form with neither gas nor reverts does not offer the op (the Huff and FP127Caller columns record any failure as not offered). calls says what each competitor cell calls. summary holds min/median/max per form, null where there is no measurement. typical (where present) is the same over random inputs that take no shortcut.
